Learned counsel for respondent No.2 would contend that when respondent No.2 was residing in the house of her husband, the petitioners being mother-in-law, brother-in-law and sister-in-law have abused her stating that she is not a suitable bride and they have unnecessarily performed her marriage with accused No.1.

(2022) 6 SCC 599 NC: 2024:KHC-D:12882 6. Having heard the learned counsel, this Court has perused the charge-sheet records and other material placed on record.
7. As per the averments of the complaint, marriage of respondent No.2 with accused No.1 has taken place on 26.04.2018 and the marriage of both of them is second marriage.
The allegations in the complaint against the petitioners are prior to 29.08.2020.
Respondent No.2 started residing in her parents house from 29.08.2020.
Thereafter, it is alleged that accused No.1-husband of respondent No.2 used to go to Belagavi.
He used to quarrel with the father and mother of respondent No.2 and in that regard, respondent No.2 has made a complaint to Mahila Police Station on 12.05.2022.
It is alleged in the complaint that on 12.05.2022, after enquiry, the accused persons came to her house and quarreled with her and asked as to why she has filed the compliant against them.
There is no mention of the name of the persons, who are alleged to have NC: 2024:KHC-D:12882 gone to her house and abused her and asked her why she has filed the complaint against them.
The allegations made in the complaint are omnibus statements and general allegations.
The allegation made against accused No.1-husband of respondent No.2 is, assault by him.
There is no individual allegations against the petitioners.

However, it is equally true, that in rec ent tim es, matrimonial litigati on in the country has also increas ed significantly and t here is a greater disaffecti on and friction s urroundi ng the i nstitution of mar riage, now, more tha n ev er.

This has res ul ted in an i ncreas ed tendency to empl oy provisions s uc h as Sec tion 498-A IPC as NC: 2024:KHC-D:12882 instruments t o settle personal sc ores agai ns t the hus band and his relatives ."
9. In the case on hand also, there are general and omnibus allegations against the petitioners.
10. Considering the said aspect, continuing the proceedings against the petitioners amounts to abuse of process of law.
11. In view of the above, the following ORDER The petition is allowed.
The proceedings against the petitioners in C.C. No.592/2023 pending on the file of the learned II JMFC Court, Belagavi, are quashed.
